title: L3 FHIR Authoring Input
description: Input schema for L3 FHIR IG authoring. Creates machine-readable FHIR artifacts from a source model.

artifactType.description: Type of FHIR artifact to author.

sourceModel.description: Path or reference to the source model the FHIR artifacts are derived from: a logical model, a business specification, a data dictionary. The layer above supplies which (a WHO SMART guideline passes its DAK's L2 content).
